source_contract.locks_and_borrows: Current thread/process/VM/iovec storage remains borrowed for the synchronous operation. Stack find/update lock nodes stay distinct and live. Remote VM hold occurs before update/process unlocks and is released exactly through the pre-existing exits. Patch changes no ownership, lock operations or lifetime.
source_contract.validation: Flags, count bounds, iovec-array coverage and equal byte totals remain unchanged. source_contract.returns: Existing CInt/int body return and CLong/long wrapper extension remain unchanged. Success returns copied. Failure retains existing negative error rather than converting prior copied bytes into partial success. Existing release ordering remains.
